create_gaussian_kernel: create a JIT-compiled Gaussian kernel function that computes normalized Gaussian values for a tensor given mean and std
build_polynomial_envelope: build a PolynomialEnvelope module with a configurable exponent that applies a smooth cutoff to scaled distance tensors
create_gaussian_smearing: create a GaussianSmearing module that embeds distance values into a fixed-width Gaussian basis representation
build_radial_mlp: build a RadialMLP module from a channel list that stacks linear layers with layer normalization and SiLU activations
test_radial_modules: test the PolynomialEnvelope, GaussianSmearing, and RadialMLP modules by running forward passes with sample tensors
